died.name: Bryan Loudermilk
died.cause: The 28-year-old father of three was found pinned beneath a rear tire of his car at his trailer home in Okeechobee, Florida. He was initially conscious, albeit unable to feel his legs before dying of traumatic asphyxia at a hospital the same day. He had willingly laid down in a shallow ditch and allowed an unidentified woman to park the car on his torso to fulfill a crush fetish, unsuccessfully using a pillow and a wooden board as cushioning. The death was deemed accidental. It was later found that Loudermilk and his wife Stephanie Tongkeamha had previously produced and sold several pornographic crushing videos in which the latter killed mice and rabbits by stepping on them.
